name: SG Mart Ltd
title: SG Mart Ltd - 512329 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 business EBITDA ~INR50 crores ex-INR6 crores inventory gain, with FY27 INR300-350 crores annualised EBITDA guide reaffirmed but hedged on Middle East and steel supply; capex of ~INR600 crores over two years is a growth bet, not discipline.

utilisation.quote: Dubai service center will also start contributing significantly
